title: Urd redirects (content/redirects.json)
description: The site's redirects, free of the host's format (ADR-0015): publishing writes the host's file from them (`_redirects` on Cloudflare Pages). Additive from v0.7. See docs/SCHEMA.md.

rules.description: The rules in order; for one old address only the first applies.

from.description: The old address: a path from the site's root without a trailing slash, its last segment a * where the rule takes everything under a folder (never `/*`, which would take Urd's own addresses).

to.description: Where visitors go: a path from the root (a query or fragment allowed) or an http(s) address; a * gives on what the old address's * took.

status.description: 301 permanent (moved for good), 302 temporary (a hidden page's address, a campaign).
